en.label: [section] Aim of the course and learning outcomes:
en.content: Review and enhance knowledge of grammar (regular verbs of the 2nd group, imparfait, passé récent, subjunctives, time phrases, indirect questions) and vocabulary (topics: food, shopping, illnesses, studying).
